text:
ITEM 1 | Cluster of rounded, golden-brown breaded or fried pieces with a crispy, slightly rough surface and a pale cream-white interior at the lower edge, topped with thin wilted green leaves with darker green edges, in a white compostable container, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm footprint, about 2.5 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Single floret-cluster of bright green broccoli with dense, bumpy buds and slightly darker tips, moist-looking with no visible sauce, about 4 cm across, sitting at upper right of the container | 35
ITEM 3 | Elongated strip of yellow-orange cooked pepper with a glossy, slightly wrinkled skin and soft texture, about 6 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, with a curved end, lying across the centre | 25
ITEM 4 | Several broccoli florets in a dark to medium green cluster with a crumbly, textured surface, lightly steamed, about 5 cm by 4 cm, arranged in the lower centre of the container | 45
ITEM 5 | Second broccoli cluster in medium green with pale stems, slightly glossy and soft, about 4 cm by 3.5 cm, positioned to the right of the yellow strip | 30
ITEM 6 | Small wedge of pale green zucchini or similar squash slice with a lighter inner flesh and smooth dark green rind, about 3 cm across, slightly moist, next to a red pepper piece | 15
ITEM 7 | Short piece of bright red pepper with glossy, smooth skin and a slightly soft texture, about 3 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, at the lower edge of the zucchini wedge | 12
ITEM 8 | Thin, flat sliver of pale orange-pink item with a smooth surface and slightly translucent edge, about 2.5 cm long, tucked beneath the broccoli cluster at lower left | 8
